title: Can I Beat a GOOSE at Chess?
summary: He plays chess.com's Valentine's Day bot lineup in order: the Bachelor (275, 'definitely not Martin'), the Ghosted bot (ghost turned pickleball coach), DJ Ron (red shades, Red Bull), Trisha, and finally the angry Goose (~3000) who just says 'honk'. He beats all except the Goose, who checkmates him with 'horrid sounds of goose laughter'.
rules: Normal chess vs a sequence of themed bots; each bot trash-talks via chat bubbles.
Bots in order: Bachelor (275) -> Ghosted -> DJ Ron -> Trisha -> Goose (~3000 Elo).
Goose's chat is 'honk' / angry honking, occasionally a long flowery sentence.
win_condition: Checkmate each bot; the final Goose is the boss (he loses to it).
